title: OpenWOP v1→v2 migration rows held by v2
description: Shape of spec/v2/major-1-migrations.json (RFC 0266 §A.2): the v1→v2 migration rows that v2 prose cites — children C2 (capabilities.md), C5 (versioning.md) and C6 (security-defaults.md) — copied verbatim from the frozen spec/v1/migrations.json (RFC 0167 §D) with an added `movedFrom` naming the v1 row. Readers merge it with the v1 register by id, the v2 row winning (scripts/lib/registers.mjs); scripts/check-migrations.mjs validates both. Not the v2→v2 register: that is spec/v2/migrations.json (RFC 0197 R1). Data, not a wire artifact; kept out of schemas/.

surface.description: Wire-visible name: a field path, header, profile id, event type, schema file, endpoint, or `none` when the v2 side removes the surface.

path.description: Where it lives: a JSON path in a document, an HTTP header slot, a file under schemas/ or spec/.

id.description: openwop.migration.<child>.<n>; child is the charter item (C1…C11).

movedFrom.description: RFC 0266 §A.2: the spec/v1/migrations.json row id this row was copied from, or null for a row born in v2.

child.description: The umbrella child (RFC 0167 §C) that owns the row.

kind.description: rename/remove/require/retype/unify/delete-alias/add are codemod-able shape changes; behavior is an obligation change with no artifact rewrite.

codemod.description: Id of the committed codemod under codemods/<id>/ (scripts/check-codemods.mjs). Required for kind ∈ {rename, remove, retype, unify, delete-alias} at the umbrella's Active predicate; null while the child is Draft.

persistedData.description: What happens to data a v1 host already persisted under the v1 surface (RFC 0167 §C.9): unchanged (readable as-is), translated (read through the declared adapter / codemod), drained (in-flight only; ends by policy), legacy-stamped (marked with a legacy value, never rewritten), never-upgraded (stays valid v1 evidence), not-persisted (transient wire only).

requirementIds.description: conformance/requirements.json ids (or planned v2 ids) that witness the v2 side.

gapIds.description: spec/v1/gaps.json rows this migration closes or carries.

deprecationId.description: The deprecation row for the v1 surface, in spec/v1/deprecations.json or spec/v2/deprecations.json (merged by id), when one exists (every rename/remove/delete-alias row MUST have one — scripts/check-migrations.mjs).
